nodes.label: Docker Compose
nodes.summary: Container orchestration building and starting dashboard, API, crawler worker, PostgreSQL, and Redis with mounted ordered migrations.

nodes.label: Fastify
nodes.summary: HTTP framework underlying the API server application under apps/api.

nodes.label: Next.js
nodes.summary: Framework used for the web dashboard application under apps/web.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.summary: Durable product state store holding projects, API keys, source documents, jobs, analytics, and interactions.

nodes.label: Redis
nodes.summary: Disposable cache layer used for response caching in the stack.

nodes.label: BM25 Ranking
nodes.summary: The default ranking function scoring per field with k1=1.2 and b=0.75 defaults, controlling term-frequency saturation and length normalization.

nodes.label: Fuzzy Matching
nodes.summary: Typo tolerance expanding candidate terms through vocabulary length buckets and Levenshtein edit distance with penalties so exact matches outrank fuzzy ones.

nodes.label: Inverted Index
nodes.summary: Dictionary mapping normalized terms to field postings storing document ID, term frequency, positions, and offsets, with reverse document-to-term sets for efficient updates and deletes.

nodes.label: Phrase Search
nodes.summary: Quoted-phrase matching that intersects same-field postings and aligns sorted position lists without rescanning original text.

nodes.label: Top-K Heap
nodes.summary: Generic binary min-heap retaining only offset+limit best candidates with O(log k) push/pop and O(k) memory.

nodes.label: Trie Autocomplete
nodes.summary: Prefix-tree based autocomplete whose suggestions traverse only the prefix subtree and are ordered by document frequency.

nodes.label: BM25 Defaults k1=1.2 b=0.75
nodes.summary: Default BM25 parameters where k1 controls term-frequency saturation and b controls length normalization.

nodes.label: @seekr/search-core
nodes.summary: Dependency-free lexical search engine implementing token-based indexing, retrieval, ranking, filters, facets, autocomplete, typo tolerance, phrases, highlighting, explanations, and immutable-segment persistence.

nodes.label: Benchmarking
nodes.summary: Benchmark suite measuring tokenization, indexing throughput, memory, lookups, ranking, facets, autocomplete, fuzzy matching, and segment persistence with percentile reporting.

nodes.label: Query Pipeline
nodes.summary: Search flow from query parser through tokenizer, candidate retrieval from posting lists, BM25/TF-IDF scoring, ranking rules, and top-K heap selection.

nodes.label: Relevance Evaluation
nodes.summary: Helpers computing Precision@K, Recall@K, MRR, DCG, and NDCG from judged fixtures to compare ranking configurations.

nodes.label: Dependency Direction Rule
nodes.summary: Applications may import packages but algorithm packages never import applications; storage interfaces keep the engine independent of adapters.

nodes.label: No Hosted Services Decision
nodes.summary: Decision that core code never calls a hosted search, vector, embedding, or recommendation API; all algorithms live in this repository.

nodes.label: Single Active Writer Boundary
nodes.summary: Current release supports one active API/index writer and one crawler worker because the in-process live index is not coordinated across replicas.

nodes.label: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Contribution workflow covering development commands, quality gates, extension points, and pull-request expectations.

nodes.summary: Project overview covering features, architecture diagrams, quick start, structure, commands, and roadmap.

nodes.label: Seekr
nodes.summary: A self-hosted search and recommendation engine implemented from first principles in TypeScript, not a wrapper around hosted search services.

nodes.label: pnpm + Turborepo
nodes.summary: Workspace and task-graph tooling requiring Node.js 24+, pnpm 11+, orchestrating builds, tests, and caching.

nodes.label: TypeScript
nodes.summary: Strict TypeScript monorepo language used across all apps and packages.

nodes.label: Vitest
nodes.summary: Deterministic test framework run via pnpm test across the repository.

nodes.label: Immutable Segments
nodes.summary: Persistence architecture where documents flush into immutable segments ordered by a manifest with tombstones, enabling lock-light readers, compaction, and atomic manifest swaps.

nodes.label: Snapshots
nodes.summary: Checksummed index backups created via temporary directory plus atomic rename and restored through verified staging with rollback on failure.

nodes.label: Architecture Documentation
nodes.summary: Documentation explaining data structures, equations, examples, and complexity of the algorithm packages.

nodes.label: Audit Report
nodes.summary: Architecture and code-quality audit listing fixed P0-P3 issues and remaining technical debt such as segment-backed hot index adoption.

nodes.label: Docs Index
nodes.summary: Documentation index linking use guides and understanding material for Seekr.

nodes.label: @seekr/tokenizer
nodes.summary: Dependency-free Unicode-aware text-processing pipeline shared by indexing and query analysis with ordered stages including normalization, stop-word removal, optional stemming, and n-grams.

nodes.label: Indexing Pipeline
nodes.summary: Document flow from validation through tokenization, term statistics, posting-list updates, and flush into immutable segments.

nodes.label: Scoped API Keys
nodes.summary: Random project-scoped keys stored as salted scrypt hashes, shown once, scope-checked, expiration-aware, and revocable.

nodes.label: Robots Policy
nodes.summary: Per-origin robots.txt handling cached once per origin where the SeekrBot group takes precedence over *, implementing User-agent, Allow, Disallow, and Crawl-delay directives.

nodes.label: SSRF Protection
nodes.summary: Crawler defenses rejecting literal and DNS-resolved private, loopback, link-local, documentation, multicast, and reserved addresses at every redirect hop.

nodes.label: SECURITY.md
nodes.summary: Vulnerability reporting policy, deployment security checklist, implemented controls, and supported-version policy.

nodes.label: Crawler
nodes.summary: A conservative breadth-first website ingester with URL policy, robots rules, per-origin rate limiting, fetching, extraction, deduplication, and indexing via an injected PageIndexSink.

nodes.label: Cheerio
nodes.summary: Library providing deterministic server-side DOM parsing used for readable-content extraction.

nodes.label: Collaborative Filtering
nodes.summary: Item-item and user-user filtering treating items/users as sparse vectors of interaction weights compared by cosine similarity.

nodes.label: Content-Based Recommendation
nodes.summary: Recommender building L2-normalized sparse TF-IDF item vectors and comparing them with cosine similarity against weighted user profiles.

nodes.label: Hybrid Recommendations
nodes.summary: Recommender combining normalized content, collaborative, popularity, and recency signals with configured weights and graceful cold-start fallbacks.

nodes.label: TF-IDF
nodes.summary: Selectable ranking using term frequency and smoothed inverse document frequency; also the basis of sparse content vectors for recommendations.

nodes.label: @seekr/recommendation-core
nodes.summary: Framework-neutral recommendation algorithms providing weighted interaction storage, popularity, sparse TF-IDF content similarity, cached item-item collaborative filtering, and normalized hybrid scoring.
